_doc: The T-slot of MISUMI's 5 series (20 mm) aluminium extrusions (HFS and its sister types). Opening, lip, cavity width and depth are printed on MISUMI's pages; the width of the floor and the angle of the flanks are scaled off its drawing, and say so. Drawn by cad rules draw to hold against the page.
name: slot-6-misumi

opening.rule: Slot width between the lips (the catalogue calls the 5 series (20 mm) "slot width 6")
opening.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-529, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_529.pdf

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the underside of the lip, dimensioned on the section drawing
lip_thickness.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-529, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_529.pdf

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips: "T Slot Dimension 12mm"
cavity_width.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-527, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_527.pdf

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the slot's floor: "Slot Depth 6mm"
cavity_depth.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-527, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_527.pdf

floor_width.rule: Width of the flat floor, where the flanks land on the core: the drawing shows walls straight down to 2.9 mm below the face, then flanks closing in. Not dimensioned: measure yours
floor_width.source: scaled off the section drawing on MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-529, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_529.pdf (the drawing prints no figure for it)

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, as drawn. Not dimensioned
flank_angle.source: scaled off the section drawing on MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-529, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_529.pdf (the drawing prints no figure for it)

nut_family.rule: It takes MISUMI's own nuts for this series; another maker's nut is not promised to fit
nut_family.source: MISUMI FA Mechanical Standard Components catalogue 2014, page 2-527, https://my.misumi-ec.com/pdf/fa/2014/p2_527.pdf
